columns.name: ActivityInstanceId
columns.description: Identifies the unique location of the Practice within a Brightspace course. If a Practice appears multiple times in a course, this value changes but the CourseId and ProviderObjectId remain the same.

columns.name: CreatedById
columns.description: Identifies the user who created the Practice.

columns.name: OrgUnitId
columns.description: Identifies the Brightspace organizational unit containing the Practice. Field can be null.

columns.name: PracticeTitle
columns.description: The title provided by the creator of the Practice.

columns.name: ProviderObjectId
columns.description: ID of the Practice on the provider service. If a Practice is copied to multiple courses, the CourseId and ProviderObjectId should both change. Field can be null.

columns.name: CreatedDate
columns.description: The date and time (UTC) the Practice was created. For Practices created before July 2024, this is the date the Practice was transformed into a data-enabled Practice.

columns.name: Version
columns.description: Indicates the version of the row. This information is used to determine which table row occurred first.
